# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them via GitHub's private [Security Advisories](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/finetuning-regression-tester/security/advisories/new) feature. Include as much detail as possible: a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and potential impact.

If private vulnerability reporting is unavailable, email [work@withrana.com](mailto:work@withrana.com). Do not include vulnerability details in a public discussion or issue.

Maintainers aim to acknowledge reports promptly. Once a report is confirmed, they will share the available details and a resolution timeline.
